name: ZeroCloud Cast
description: Cast from any device to any device, including your Google TV.
introduction: We’re building Cast to bring one device’s screen onto another. Choose where to watch, present or share a screen.

overview.heading: Your screen. On the screen you choose.

steps.title: Choose a screen
steps.description: Start with the device you want to cast from.

steps.title: Choose a destination
steps.description: Connect to another device, a browser or Google TV.

steps.title: Start casting
steps.description: Approved recipients and an encrypted connection are requirements.

note.title: A place for your bigger screen.
note.description: Google TV is included in the platform plan, alongside desktop, Android and the Web. Public builds and web links will appear in Downloads.

faqs.question: Which direction can I cast?
faqs.answer: The product goal is any device to any device. Cast is being designed around choosing a source and a destination, rather than a fixed phone and TV pairing.

faqs.question: Will Cast support Google TV?
faqs.answer: Google TV is a planned target and has its own entry in Downloads. There is no published build to download yet.

faqs.question: Will there be a Web version?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Web is part of the platform plan. The Open web app action will become available when a public URL is ready.

faqs.question: Who can see my screen?
faqs.answer: Cast is being designed for the destination you approve. Encrypted connections and control over who receives the screen are required parts of the product.
